notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Squirrel, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
